title: # Job: land-everything (Urgent profile) Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice): "Fuck the review, I review it.
asked: # Job: land-everything (Urgent profile) Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice): "Fuck the review, I review it. Just go. Get everything live." He is away; land the finished work on main and get it deployed. He explicitly waived UI Review for these (EXCEPT banners, see below). ## First - Register in the Urgent profile via the orchestrator CLI (id `land-everything`) + banner entry. orch-live-sync is on main (live status writes, reconciler, claude-sync auto-resolve rules): use its tools for every store write and conflict. - Check the `land` job type (`node framework/cli/agent-job.mjs list`); if an agent owns landing, you are acting for it this once at Brett's request; book it there if the tooling allows. ## How to land each one For each branch below, in this order: fetch, merge origin/main into the branch in its worktree (/root/axf-builds/<name> where it exists, else a fresh worktree), resolve, run the repo's local CI block (tsc, vite builds of affected apps, check-theme, check-controls, plugin lifecycle, tests touched), push the branch, then fast-forward/merge to main and push main (never force). Close the PR as merged (or merge it via GitHub API) and update its build in the store (complete, per-step branch/pr/merged/mergedAt). Conflict rules: - `_claude/builds/store.json`: merge per record (build, step) by rev/updatedAt, newest wins, never drop a record from either side; then regenerate all exports (`orchestrator.json`, profiles/*/orchestrator.json, pending, queue) from the merged store. Journal `_claude/builds/journal/*.jsonl`: union of lines, dedupe identical, keep chronological order. - THREADS.md, STATUS.md, decisions.md, LOG.md, notes/sessions/handoffs: union merge. Build reports: keep the branch's version (it's that build's own report) unless main's is newer for the same build. - Hub-synced copies (changes/*.json, _claude/shared/notes/**, apps/*/_claude/**): identical = fine; differing = newer wins. - REAL code conflicts: resolve them properly if the intent of both sides is clear (both features must keep working; run the tests). If you can't resolve one safely, skip that branch, leave it pushed, and record exactly why in the report; keep going with the rest. ## Order 1. claude/notes-vault (PR #256) 2. claude/agent-chats-hub (PR #248) - Brett wants this one live ASAP (Breakroom group chat viewer) 3. claude/kill-patches-pilot (AmberX PR; its axHub PR too, in /root/axHub or a fresh clone) 4. claude/headless-tabs (PR #259) 5. claude/whats-new-banner (PR #260) 6. claude/molly-fable (PR #245, dock engine) then claude/xlayout-opus (PR #252) 7. claude/token-control (PR #246) then claude/token-control-opus (PR #250) then claude/console-commands (PR #249) 8. claude/theme-editor (PR #243), claude/one-look-default-2 (PR #244), claude/model-upgrade-approval (PR #253) 9. When they finish (check `vps` builds / tmux axf-theme-veto-pass, axf-plugin-commands-auto): claude/theme-veto-pass (after #250) and claude/plugin-commands-auto (after #250, #249, #256); and the axHub repo branch claude/axhub-veto-pass. Wait for them if they're still running (poll every few minutes, up to 3 hours). DO NOT land: claude/banner-pack (#251), claude/banner-editor (#254), claude/banners-one (Brett wants to review banners himself). Leave them untouched. ## After landing - Make sure deploys ran (deploy workflow / Coolify) and the console, axHub web, AmberX web and Molly are up and healthy (docker ps, HTTP 200 on their domains). - Register the console's MCP (`axf-console` and token-control's MCP) as axHub services if not already (`~/hub/bin/axhub services ...` per axHub examples/README.md), policy preset: reads allow, writes veto, deletes confirm (use the preset from axhub-veto-pass if landed). - Confirm status-only commits to main don't trigger full redeploys (paths-ignore from orch-live-sync s9); if they still do, fix the workflow. - Tick items on Brett's checklist only if they're his and now done: /projects/_shared/_claude/notes/checklist-one.md (via the hub memory API). …
